description: Local MCP protocol contract (macOS MCPRouter, MCPHTTPRequest, MCPTools definitions). Transport is JSON-over-HTTP, one request per connection, no server-initiated SSE.

httpFraming.head:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:19847
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
Content-Length: 2

flow.step: initialize with token and unknown protocol version

isolation.step: client two reuses client one's session id
client one revoked, then ping on its session

claudeDesktop.mergeRule: Insert or replace only mcpServers.clio. Preserve every other key and server.
